<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Upset Balance](/Feats.aspx?ID=4177) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 110

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172); Expert in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3)

**Trigger**
You are damaged by a melee Strike.

**Requirements**
You are in Tenacious Stance.

</column>

---

You lean into your foe's attack, using the weight of your body and armor to send them reeling. Attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check against the  creature's Reflex DC. On a success, the target becomes [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) until the end of its next turn (clumsy 2 on a critical success). If you are [anchored](/Feats.aspx?ID=4174), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.
name: Upset Balance
prerequisite: Stalwart Defender Dedication; Expert in Athletics
